test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'OVERT' is written as 'LEVIG' and 'MOKIN' is written as 'NLPRM’. How will 'ILICO' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Letters is getting reversed**.

Now, 'OVERT' is written as 'LEVIG'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7c4d812195173f12256eab3b60deed24d478f341f8c865a7bf6e6d8fad154b0.png] 

For, 'MOKIN' is written as 'NLPRM’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aabff5764355c0beaaac92e03bac21d3c194612b1d7217df721d94d43ca58f1b.png] 

Similarly, for 'ILICO'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6377459f76dbc13c64991c46548b8f1309806861f6f01a0360cf8dd7551dfbb2.png] 

So, 'ILICO' will be written as 'RORXL'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
